rationale: The unit introduces a place expression p by its variable-rooted field route and gives the three operational cases in ordinary language before using formal judgments. Mode and Reference put unique/shared on references, and the supporting State.Object definition has no ownership-mode field. Resolve.variable begins with the stored mode; Resolve.field propagates the join of prefix and final-reference modes. Give.move requires unique resolution plus Take, Give.copy requires shared resolution and a stored shared reference and returns the original state, and Give.promote requires shared resolution plus Promote. Take replaces the final unique reference with none; Promote replaces precisely that occurrence with a shared reference of the same object. Their constructors preserve other entries and the counter. Thus the result identity, initialized-source behavior, and final-slot-only promotion in all three table rows match. The inspected Eval.giveShare definition in context:lean/Shared/Step.lean changes the returned reference's mode only, so sharing a container does not recursively change field modes. Compatible constrains multiple owners to shared occurrences, consistently with the introductory motivation.
